questions.q: Which word means "to turn over in the air"?
questions.why: Flip = turn over in the air.

questions.q: Kitesurfers need lots of ____ in their arms.
questions.why: Strength comes from strong.

questions.q: You can fly at a ____ of 6,000 m when hang-gliding.
questions.why: Height = how high.

questions.q: The ____ of the top tube is 38 cm.
questions.why: The top tube is long, so we measure its length.

questions.q: Serious ____ are not common in hang-gliding.
questions.why: An accident is something bad that you didn't plan.

questions.q: He broke his arm. It was a bad ____.
questions.why: An injury is a hurt part of your body.

questions.q: What are kitesurfers called?
questions.why: The book calls them Charlie Browners.

questions.q: Which is NOT a sport?
questions.why: Strength is a noun meaning power, not a sport.

questions.q: The secret message is: Extreme sports are ____!
questions.why: The words left are extreme sports, are, cool.

questions.q: A: What's the worst injury you've ever had? B: ____
questions.why: The answer must be an injury.

questions.q: Surfing ____ my favorite sport for many years.
questions.why: Surfing = it → has been.

questions.q: Many people have had accidents ____ last year.
questions.why: Last year is a point in time → since.

questions.q: Skiing has been my dad's favorite sport ____ the last twenty years.
questions.why: Twenty years is a period of time → for.

questions.q: He ____ to go skiing since he was a boy.
questions.why: He → has + wanted.

questions.q: People ____ kitesurfing since 2000.
questions.why: People = they → have enjoyed.

questions.q: More than 10 million people have ____ skateboarding since the 1960s.
questions.why: try → tried (y changes to i).

questions.q: How long have you ____ a bicycle?
questions.why: have → had (past participle).

questions.q: In 2026, "since 2014" is the same as ____.
Which goes with FOR?
questions.why: A month is a period of time.

questions.q: Which goes with SINCE?
questions.why: "I was born" is a point in time.

questions.q: Protect your elbows by wearing ____.
questions.why: Elbow pads protect elbows.

questions.q: If you fall in the water, a ____ helps you float.
questions.why: A life jacket helps you float.

questions.q: Check your bicycle ____ often so you can stop quickly.
questions.why: Brakes make a bicycle stop.

questions.q: Skateboarders should wear a ____ so they won't hurt their head.
questions.why: A helmet protects your head.

questions.q: In the workbook photos, who is wearing a life jacket?
questions.why: The person in the kayak (d) wears a life jacket.

questions.q: Skateboarding is ____ cool.
questions.why: Use the adverb really before the adjective.

questions.q: Which sentence is correct?
questions.why: Adverb + adjective: incredibly scary.

questions.q: Those knee pads ____ super silly.
questions.why: Those knee pads = they → look.

questions.q: Which word is an adverb of emphasis?
questions.why: Extremely makes an adjective stronger.

questions.q: A: This sport looks extremely dangerous. B: That's true. But it's ____ cool!
questions.why: totally + cool.

questions.q: Which word rhymes with "hair"?
questions.why: hair and wear both have the air sound.

questions.q: Which word rhymes with "here"?
questions.why: here and cheer both have the ear sound.

questions.q: Which pair has DIFFERENT sounds?
questions.why: deer has the ear sound, dare has the air sound.

questions.q: Danny MacAskill is a famous ____.
questions.why: He flips off buildings on his bicycle.

questions.q: Bethany Hamilton lost her left arm when a ____ attacked her.
questions.why: A shark attacked her when she was 13.

questions.q: Since then, Bethany ____ to surf with one arm.
questions.why: Since then + present perfect: has learned.

questions.q: I think Bethany is ____ than Danny.
questions.why: brave → braver.

questions.q: Jade Etherington can see only ____ percent.
questions.why: She has just 5 percent vision.

questions.q: Felipe Nunes is a skateboarder from ____.
questions.why: The workbook says he is Brazilian.

questions.q: What does "connect with nature" mean?
options: spend time outdoors and care about nature
watch nature videos on a phone
questions.why: It means being outside and caring about the natural world.

questions.q: Which is a linking word for a biography?
questions.why: Afterward links events in time.

questions.q: Matt Moniz climbed Mount Everest for the first time with his ____.
questions.why: His father invited him to join a climb.
